Q06 partial essential setup controls, not full keyboard acceptance
before: Saving from max-recordings natively disables the fieldset and Save, leaving BODY during save and failure. Incomplete setup with automatic preparation off remains legally saveable.
implementation: Move Save outside the native-disabled workflow fieldset; preserve native enabled busy state with aria-disabled/busy and visible focus. Eligible explicit in-form submit focuses/reveals Save synchronously. Clean success retains focus only until blur.

Add a synchronous explicit-save entry guard through onSettled; keep existing global roomConfiguration lock/generic Updating room settings status across page unmount/return. Key the WorkflowPreferences owner by profile ID to reset local focus intent.

Route explicit save errors through a tagged App-owned operationError slot. Show one ErrorNotice immediately above Save on settings, and the existing top notice on other tabs. Other configuration errors stay untagged in their existing locations.

Inner persist retains mutation key/onMutate/write/readback but no generic onError callback. Its three outer callers own errors: explicit save tags, profile save-and-switch reports through profiles, manual preparation stores its own error.

Changed failure text reveals the error/Save wrapper only while that Save still has actual focus, its panel is visible, window is focused/visible and no overlay is open. Skip persisted errors on remount; never focus from a completion effect. Readiness checks, provider authorization and backend writes unchanged.

pairedDecision.Steve: Independent native-locked fields/Save anchor proposal; supports existing global pending ownership and reviews synchronous local guard. Initial error proposal used separate workflowSaveError; caller audit converges to one tagged error slot with outer error ownership. Reviewed integration without blocker.
pairedDecision.Elena: Independent native-locked fields/current-focus retention proposal; implements WorkflowPreferences and visible wrapper. Proposes tagged persistent error routing after intermediate failure screenshot; supports outer-only error reporting after challenge.
pairedDecision.Morgan: Owns integration, parent profile key, explicit save ref, error routing and native verification. Simplifies room-tag state using keyed component. Reopens focus-only decision because intermediate error is offscreen; no whole-app acceptance promotion.

sourceTraceSupplement.text: Settings contains account/libraries, DJ playback and transitions, provider keys, shared sources, and reusable DJs. When explicitly saving General DJ playback or transition preferences, keep visible keyboard focus on Save while fields lock and readback completes. Ignore repeated save activation. Keep a failed draft editable for an explicit retry. A successful clean Save retains its current focus until the user moves on, then leaves the Tab order. Later Tab or section/page navigation wins; completing a save elsewhere must not reclaim focus. Saving or removing a provider key keeps its confirmed status authoritative over older status reads, including checks started while saving. Check only that provider again after a failed save, retain its entered draft and error while checking, and keep editing available. Keep masked key drafts, pending save/removal and failure feedback through music navigation and Settings section changes. These drafts exist only in memory. Keys apply to this app on this Mac across music accounts. Signing out or changing account identity clears entered key text and settled errors; an already-started key change can finish, and its provider remains locked until settlement. Its confirmed status applies globally, but its old-session failure must not reappear in the new account. Show this pending-write caveat in sign-out confirmation while a key change is saving. A status check never prepares text or audio. News bucket → Settings edits the chosen profile and its preparation schedule. Keep one combined draft for sources, host, mood, interests, and preparation preferences. Preserve it through music navigation and shared-management visits. Distinguish draft activation from saved running state, and offer save/discard/cancel for all fields before switching profiles. Save setup and workflow choices atomically. An explicit setup save keeps visible focus on Save while the combined fields lock and saved-state readback finishes. Ignore repeated submission. Failed saves retain the draft and show one explanation beside Save for explicit retry; keep that explanation when returning to setup. Reveal it with Save only while Save still owns focus. Success keeps the clean Save focusable only until focus leaves. Later Tab, profile or page navigation wins. Returning during a pending configuration change shows the existing update status and keeps editing locked without restoring an old focus target. Gate enabled preparation on current sources, saved host, mood, and required key status; allow incomplete setup and disabling preparation without keys.

| R2 | As a listener, I can set up a familiar host | Music is playing; I want occasional science news | Add a source, choose a preset DJ, enter interests and mood, edit cadence, visit music, return and save setup | Music continues; all draft fields survive navigation and persist on explicit save; Save retains visible focus through the combined write/readback, rejects duplicate submission and keeps failed drafts with one visible explanation beside Save for retry and after returning; success retains clean Save only while focused, and later Tab/profile/page navigation wins; returning during pending configuration shows its update status with editing locked; missing requirements offer direct setup actions; incomplete setup can be saved with preparation off and no keys; a copy retains the drafted setup without saving the original, starts unavailable with preparation off and requires availability plus a separate preparation opt-in; neither switch silently turns on; long saved names and recovery messages keep setup actions reachable |
